_comment: The failure the Releases channel exists to prevent, recorded as input. The News archive currently holds THREE separate posts about ONE GPT-6 Astra release — gpt-6-astra-a-new-era-for-developers, gpt-6-astra-redefining-intelligence-and-efficiency-for-developers and understanding-the-impact-of-openai-s-gpt-6-astra-on-enterprise-operations — published on 4, 5 and 6 September 2026 from three different URLs under three different headlines. URL dedup cannot see that they are one story; title dedup catches some of it and missed these; entity dedup on (vendor, family, version, eventType) collapses all of them. The source URLs below are the real ones from those three posts' frontmatter. The fourth item is a press pickup, present to show that a corroborating source adds a point and can never trigger a post on its own; the fifth is an unrelated release that must survive as its own candidate, so the test is measuring dedup rather than over-merging.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra is our most capable model. It represents years of work in pre-training, reinforcement learning and alignment. Astra saturates top-tier benchmarks including FrontierMath Tier 4 at 98% and ARC-AGI-3 at 99.9%, and completes professional tasks with 47% less time per task than GPT-5.6 Sol. Available today in the API with a 1.05 million token context window.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra: a new era for developers
items.summary: gpt-6-astra is now available in the API. The model supports a 1.05M context window, computer use, and structured outputs. See the model card for benchmark results including FrontierMath Tier 4 (98%).

items.title: Introducing GPT-6 Astra for developers
items.summary: I have been playing with GPT-6 Astra since yesterday. The 1.05M context window is the headline but the interesting part is how much better it is at long multi-step tasks.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra, a 1.05M-context computer-use model gated behind a critical cyber threshold
items.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra. The model is notable for its enhanced performance and cost-effectiveness on reasoning-heavy tasks, with a 1.05 million token context window.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash is our new workhorse model, with a significant uptick in first-pass code accuracy. It scores 43.6% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main and 65.3% on DeepSWE v1.1, against 34.4% and 49.0% for 3.6 Flash.

items.title: Ollama v0.14.2
items.summary: Fixes a regression in model unloading. Adds support for the new GPT-6 Astra tokenizer.
